name: How do I keep design consistent throughout a whole-home renovation?

mainEntity.name: How do I keep design consistent throughout a whole-home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A cohesive design concept, shared material palette, and coordinated details for trim, doors, hardware, and lighting ensure spaces feel connected even when room functions differ.
